# porch_user (Resource)

An installation user (a person). Users sign in with linked upstream identities; the primary email is an attribute only and never links login identities. Add users to tenants with `porch_tenant_member`. Requires an installation `admin` token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "porch_user" "ada" {
  display_name  = "Ada Smith"
  primary_email = "ada@smith.example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `primary_email` (String) Primary email address (lowercase).
- `status` (String) `active` (default) or `disabled`. Disabling a user ends all of their sessions immediately.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) User ID (`usr_…`).
- `public_id` (String) Stable OIDC subject (`sub`) of the user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_user.ada usr_01h...
```
